description: The cable end preparation: in full, each step with the design's own cut depths and the diameter left, the makers' cut-back lengths for this voltage and size (each with its maker), for an MV design the kinds of termination and joint kit that fit it (kits: their ranges, length and shed count from the makers' public catalogues, no maker or kit named), and the step sheet (PDF); the free verdict is the common step order every visitor sees, each step with its sources. Without full and without payment the answer is the verdict a visitor sees on the site, counted against the designs' daily free allowance; full: true (or any paid call) answers in full. A separate paid call at its own price. input: none (the design decides; the kit's own instruction wins over the makers' lengths). $0.50 per calculation in USDC with x402; the free verdict counts against the designs' 2 free calls per caller per UTC day; a list of up to 50 items at $0.50 per item, one payment.
